controller.pattern: BaseController with concrete implementations per strategy
key_components: BaseController abstract class managing signal generation lifecycle
ControllerConfig holding symbol, strategy_name, score_threshold, cooldown, max_concurrent_signals
StepIndexController - trend following + mean reversion for Step Index instruments
VolatilityController - mean reversion with regime detection
RangeBreakController - channel breakout detection
DriftBoomCrashController - drift detection on boom/crash indices
ConfluenceController - dual confirmation (breakout + volatility)
Factory function create_controller() mapping strategy names to controller classes
controller.signal_flow: Controller receives market data → generates Signal → publishes Event(SIGNAL_GENERATED) to message bus → Executor subscribes and acts

executor.pattern: BaseExecutor with concrete DerivExecutor and PaperExecutor
key_components: ExecutorConfig holding symbol, strategy_name, max_position_duration, default_stake
BaseExecutor abstract class with execute_order(), subscribe(), on_signal_validated()
DerivExecutor - real Deriv API via WebSocket: get_proposal() → buy() → contract management
PaperExecutor - simulation: instant fill, _monitor_paper_position() for TP/SL/time exit
RiskEngine validation passed before any order submission
Factory function create_executor() mapping executor types to classes
executor.order_flow: Signal received → RiskEngine.validate_order() → if passed: DerivExecutor.buy() or PaperExecutor simulated fill → Position added to Portfolio → P&L recorded in RiskEngine

paper_trading.pattern: PaperExecutor simulates Deriv trading for paper trading phase
key_components: Instant fill simulation - paper trades fill immediately on signal
_monitor_paper_position() - tracks TP/SL/expiry with time-based exit
Records P&L in RiskEngine.record_fill() for daily stats tracking
Publishes POSITION_OPENED and POSITION_CLOSED events on message bus
Uses same RiskEngine validation as live trading (2% per trade, 5% daily DD, circuit breaker)
default_stake configurable, Position objects track entry/exit, P&L, contract_id
Integration points: subscribes to SIGNAL_GENERATED events, outputs contract_id and mode='paper'
paper_trading.paper_trading_gate: Phase 3 requires 30+ paper trades, profitable, no day >-5% before live trading approval

strategy_registry.pattern: Plug-in interface via abstract Strategy base class
key_components: Strategy ABC with abstract methods: generate_signal(data: pd.DataFrame) -> Signal, get_win_probability(signal: Signal) -> float
Signal dataclass: type(SignalType), symbol, entry_price, stop_loss, take_profit, duration_seconds, confidence(0-1), metadata
Concrete strategies: StepIndexStrategy (EMA trend + ATR reversion), VolatilityStrategyV2, RangeBreakStrategy, DriftBoomCrashStrategy, ConfluenceStrategy, AggressiveBreakoutStrategy
STEP_SIZE_PCT dict: step size per symbol (STEPT10=0.001, STEPT100=0.010, stpRNG=0.000003)

StepIndexConfig: ema_fast_period(9), ema_slow_period(21), ema_midline_period(20), atr_period(14), min_candles(30), step_size_pct, reversion_steps(1.5), reversion_max_steps(4.0), trend_weight(0.6), reversion_weight(0.4), sl_steps(2.0), tp_steps(3.0), max_duration(600), score_threshold(0.15)
Factory pattern: create_controller() and create_executor() for runtime instantiation
Strategy registration by name in controller/executor factory dicts
strategy_registry.strategy_interface_contract: All strategies must implement: generate_signal(data) → Signal and get_win_probability(signal) → float in [0.55, 0.70] range for Kelly sizing

decisions.rationale: Separation of concerns: Controllers decide WHAT to trade (signal generation), Executors handle HOW to trade (order routing/fill). Enables independent testing, per-strategy controller logic, per-executor API integration. Matches Hummingbot V2 + NautilusTrader pattern already referenced in codebase.
decisions.tradeoffs: Added latency from message bus indirection, but enables parallel controller/executor development and substitution (e.g., DerivExecutor ↔ PaperExecutor) without affecting strategy logic

decisions.decision: RiskEngine as central validation gate for all orders
decisions.rationale: Single source of truth for PROJECT.md risk rules: 2% max risk per trade, 5% daily drawdown, 10 trades max per day, circuit breaker after consecutive losses. All orders (Deriv or paper) must pass validation. Prevents config drift between live and paper modes. Enables quarter-Kelly position sizing with volatility adjustments.
decisions.tradeoffs: One extra validation step before execution, but eliminates risk rule bugs and enables consistent risk tracking across all execution modes

decisions.rationale: Type-safe event backbone with Pub/Sub + Req/Rep enables decoupled controller→executor communication, supports multiple executor types (paper/deriv) subscribing to same signals, and provides correlation_id tracking for trade attribution. The typed implementation (message_bus_typed.py) provides compile-time safety.
decisions.tradeoffs: Slightly more complex setup vs direct calls, but enables the paper/deriv executor swap pattern and diagnostic event tracing

decisions.decision: PaperExecutor simulates instant fills with time-based monitoring
decisions.rationale: Paper trading phase needs rapid validation of strategies without Deriv API rate limits. Instant fill allows accumulating 30+ trades quickly. _monitor_paper_position() simulates TP/SL/expiry with placeholders for later live price feed integration. Shares same RiskEngine for consistent risk tracking.
decisions.tradeoffs: Instant fill doesn't model slippage or order book dynamics; Phase 3 gate requires 30+ trades before live transition, acknowledging this limitation

decisions.decision: Strategy plug-in interface via abstract base class
decisions.rationale: Enables new strategies (mean reversion, momentum, stat-arb) to be added without modifying controller/executor core. Each strategy implements generate_signal + get_win_probability. The StepIndexStrategy already demonstrates the hybrid trend+reversion pattern with known step size for deterministic risk. Factory functions auto-register by name.
decisions.tradeoffs: Need to ensure all strategies adhere to the Signal interface; missing methods break the pipeline. Mitigated by factory validation and LSP live_diagnostics gate

decisions.decision: score_threshold 0.15 for StepIndex vs 0.35 default for other controllers
decisions.rationale: Step Index has 'less structural noise' per step_index.py:135, so lower threshold (0.15) allows more signals. Other strategies use 0.35 default. This difference is config-driven, not code-enforced, allowing per-strategy tuning.
decisions.tradeoffs: Lower threshold means more NO_SIGNAL rejections from score_below_threshold, but increases trade frequency for Step Index where edge is quantified via win probability ~62%
